source: Official Annexure A catalogue supplied by the project owner, audited against the current NIRFAnalyticsEngine dispatch and methods.
scope: Static implementation audit updated after Level 1 Phase 5. This does not claim all 40 questions have passed end-to-end query parsing, Streamlit rendering and explanation testing.

status_definitions.implemented: The existing generic analytics method can directly perform the named operation when the query is populated with the required filters/slots.
status_definitions.partial: A related generic method exists, but it does not fully perform the requested derived analysis or output selection.
status_definitions.not_implemented: No current method in the analytics engine performs this operation as specified.

institution_rank_history.note: Supports year-wise rank observations when an institution filter and endpoint years are supplied.

rank_improvement.note: Computes start-rank minus end-rank for matched institutions; positive values indicate improvement.

rank_decline.note: Matches valid ranked institutions by institute_key at the endpoint years, isolates only institutions whose rank number worsened, and sorts by decline magnitude.

mean_score_by_year.note: Computes annual mean and median metric values with the valid observation count; missing values are excluded without imputation.

top10_consistency.note: Builds year-by-institution top-10 membership and selects recurrent institutions using an explicit default threshold of 60% of observed ranked years.

top_n_count_by_state.note: Supports distinct institution counts by state with a rank_limit such as 100.

state_distribution_by_year.note: Builds a state-by-year distinct-institution count matrix for the selected top-N rank band; ties at the rank cutoff are retained.

state_representation_change.note: Compares endpoint state counts and percentage-point share change in the selected top-N rank band.

compare_state_rank_distributions.note: Returns institution-level numerical ranks for exactly two selected states with state-wise median, quartiles, IQR, range and counts; supports a box plot.

new_entries_by_state.note: Finds end-year ranked institute_key values absent from the start-year ranked set and aggregates entrants by their end-year state.

score_distribution.note: Builds score histograms and descriptive distribution statistics for a selected category/year.

rank_distribution.note: Dedicated aggregation by the published rank_band values, counting distinct institute_key values per band.

score_summary.note: Calculates count, mean, median, minimum, maximum, standard deviation, quartiles and IQR.

score_quartile_share.note: Uses empirical quartiles over valid ranked institution metric scores and returns distinct-institution counts and percentages; tied values may yield fewer than four intervals.

score_spread_by_category.note: Compares raw institution-level metric observations across all selected categories in the specified year; missing values remain missing.

metric_correlation.note: Calculates Pearson and Spearman correlation on pairwise-complete records for two selected metrics.

parameter_correlation_ranking.note: Calculates pairwise Pearson and Spearman correlations between every available published parameter and overall score; ranks by absolute Pearson coefficient.

correlation_over_time.note: Calculates annual Pearson and Spearman correlations between RPC and overall score, omitting years without at least three complete varying pairs.

top_institution_parameter_profile.note: Returns top-ranked institutions and available NIRF parameter columns for profile comparison.

high_low_metric_quadrant.note: Uses category/year medians to identify the high-x/low-y quadrant; returns qualifying institutions and retains all complete records for the scatter context.

overall_vs_parameter_change.note: Matches institutions by institute_key across endpoint years and finds those with increasing overall score plus at least one paired parameter decline.

parameter_gap.note: Ranks institutions by maximum minus minimum among their available published NIRF parameter scores.

top10_vs_rest_distribution.note: Creates top-10 and remaining-institution groups using rank_num <= 10, preserving ties, and returns raw metric observations for box plots.

score_dispersion_by_year.note: Compares year-wise institution-level metric distributions across the selected period using count, mean, median, standard deviation, quartiles and IQR.

parameter_variability.note: Compares sample standard deviation across parameter columns that contain at least two observed values for the selected category/year.

median_iqr_over_time.note: Returns annual median, Q1 and Q3 values with observation counts; the renderer displays the median line and IQR band without smoothing or interpolation.

score_distribution_by_state.note: Returns institution-level metric observations grouped by state and state-level descriptive summaries; chart may select a subset of states for readability while result data retains all observations.

rank_band_transition_count.note: Counts and lists institutions moving from numeric ranks 51–100 at the start year to rank <=50 at the end year; chart displays all matched rank-band flows.

top10_entries_exits.note: Uses top-10 institute_key membership set differences for adjacent calendar years and labels missing next-year ranked records explicitly.

same_band_percentage.note: Computes overall same-rank-band retention and row-normalized start-band to end-band transition percentages using numeric rank bands.

rank_movement_extremes.note: Returns dedicated top upward and downward endpoint rank movers; positive change means numerical rank improved.

movement_counts_by_year.note: Counts up/down/unchanged rank movements across adjacent calendar years, using only institutions with valid ranks in both years.

research_score_residual_outliers.note: Regresses RPC on overall score and identifies unusually positive RPC residuals using an upper 1.5×IQR fence.

metric_difference_outliers.note: Calculates pairwise-complete RPC−TLR differences and flags unusually positive gaps using an upper 1.5×IQR fence.

score_change_outliers.note: Matches institute_key across adjacent calendar years and detects both upper and lower IQR outliers in annual score change.

metric_rank_outliers.note: Models rank number from a selected metric or each institution's strongest available parameter, then flags unusually poor positive rank residuals.

rank_volatility_outliers.note: Measures mean absolute rank movement across adjacent years and flags institutions beyond the peer-cohort upper 1.5×IQR fence.
